scope_justification: The section's introductory prose says 'We will work in the following situation.' Every theorem in this 15-candidate group explicitly begins 'Notation and assumptions as in Situation ...', independently confirming applicability. The Situation environment itself closes; its contents are reused as an explicitly designated setting, not because assumptions in arbitrary prior lemmas accumulate.
hypotheses: I is a directed indexing set, 0\in I, and (S_i)_{i\in I} is an inverse system of schemes with affine transition morphisms.
f_0:X_0\to Y_0 is a morphism of schemes over S_0.
S_0, X_0, Y_0 are quasi-compact and quasi-separated.
For every i\ge 0, f_i:X_i\to Y_i is obtained from f_0 by base change along S_i\to S_0.
f:X\to Y is the corresponding base change of f_0 along S\to S_0.
summary: Fixed inverse-system setting; no assumption that f, f0, or any fi has a specific descent property unless that is included in the individual lemma.
assumptions_that_must_not_inherit: f_0 locally of finite type (only stated in certain individual lemmas)
f_0 locally of finite presentation (only stated in certain individual lemmas)
f affine, flat, finite, smooth, etale, etc. (always specific to one lemma)
The existence index i for a prior candidate does not bind the choice for another candidate
